tests/conftest.py.name: Shared test set-up
tests/conftest.py.description: Prepares the set-ups and drawings the other checks reuse, so each one starts from the same known state.

tests/test_api.py.name: Server checks
tests/test_api.py.description: Checks the server answers each request with the right shape of result, and refuses what it should refuse.

tests/test_buoyancy.py.name: Submerged-volume checks
tests/test_buoyancy.py.description: Checks the submerged volume and the water surface against shapes whose exact answer is known.

tests/test_equilibrium.py.name: Floating-position checks
tests/test_equilibrium.py.description: Checks the platform settles where it should, and that an impossible case is reported rather than forced.

tests/test_hydro_response.py.name: Wave-behaviour checks
tests/test_hydro_response.py.description: Checks the water physics and the resulting movement on small cases, including that stored results are reused correctly.

tests/test_jobs.py.name: Slow-job checks
tests/test_jobs.py.description: Checks a slow calculation reports its progress, writes its result, and gives the same answer whether run in one go or in pieces.

tests/test_mass.py.name: Weight and balance checks
tests/test_mass.py.description: Checks the weight, balance point and spin resistance of simple shapes against the exact values.

tests/test_mooring_elements.py.name: Rope, fender and tube checks
tests/test_mooring_elements.py.description: Checks a rope only pulls, a fender only pushes and a tube does both, in still water and in waves.

tests/test_propulsion.py.name: Motor and drag checks
tests/test_propulsion.py.description: Checks the speed reached for a given motor setting, and that drag behaves sensibly as speed rises.

tests/test_reference.py.name: Reference-drawing checks
tests/test_reference.py.description: Checks the drawing package is read correctly: units, size and the positions it declares.

tests/test_scenarios.py.name: Saved-variation checks
tests/test_scenarios.py.description: Checks a saved variation reloads exactly as saved and that uncomputed values stay blank in the comparison.

tests/test_twobody.py.name: Two-craft checks
tests/test_twobody.py.description: Checks the platform and the boat settle together correctly under a push and under a tow, with the right rope loads.
